summary_en: W TOKYO establishes shareholder return policy targeting dividend payout ratio of 20% or above. Interim dividend of 20 yen per share (13 yen ordinary plus 7 yen commemorative) for fiscal year ending June 2027, with projected annual dividend of 33 yen including expected 13 yen final dividend. Company discontinues shareholder incentive program from December 31, 2026 onward.
summary_jp: 配当性向20％以上を目安とする株主還元方針を策定。2027年6月期の中間配当は1株当たり20円（普通配当13円、記念配当7円）、期末配当予想13円で、年間配当は33円。株主優待制度は2026年12月31日基準日以降廃止。
